get.description: Current sharing metadata for workspace owners and admins. No secret material.

post.description: Replace named Use grants within current workspace capabilities; check the sharing revision and append a metadata audit fact.

get.description: Retained published workflow versions using this connection. Requires connection:read and workflow:read in an active workspace.

post.description: Starts consent for an authorization-code connection and sets its short-lived browser binding cookie, replacing any consent already pending. A client-credentials connection is connected at once. Requires connection:manage in an active workspace.

200.description: Consent to open, or the connected connection

get.description: Where a provider returns the browser. The single-use state and its browser binding cookie stand in for the session and CSRF token. Every outcome is a redirect to the web landing page; its query follows OAuth2CallbackLanding. The accepted query is OAuth2CallbackQuery.
Resolves up to ten Slack channel IDs to names with the connection bot token (ADR 046). Channels that cannot be resolved are returned as unresolved with a reason.

post.description: Sends one real test message to the reviewed destination version. Replays a completed attempt with the same idempotency key; an uncertain dispatched attempt must not be sent again with a new key.
